Your cursor started telling you what you can click Back on September 26, 2026, update 0.2.2 was the first one SpaceCorps 2027 installed by itself. It made every button, tab, link and menu show the pointing hand, and in flight, every ship, alien and cargo box. Free on Steam, link in bio.
#spacegame #indiegame #indiedev #mmorpg #mmo #gamedev #pcgaming #scifi #freetoplay #spaceships

No more downloading every version by hand Back on September 26, 2026, update 0.2.1 taught SpaceCorps 2027 to update itself. Versions download in the background and install on restart. If one fails to start, the old one comes back. Free on Steam, link in bio.
#spacegame #indiegame #indiedev #mmorpg #mmo #gamedev #pcgaming #scifi #freetoplay #spaceships

You stopped being the only one on your side Back on September 26, 2026, update 0.2.0 brought friendly company pilots to SpaceCorps 2027. Small squads patrolled your company's maps and joined your fights. Same update: glowing HDR graphics and 10 languages. Free on Steam, link in bio.
#spacegame #indiegame #indiedev #mmorpg #mmo #gamedev #pcgaming #scifi #freetoplay #spaceships

The browser prototype's last update Back on February 15, 2026, update 0.0.13 added 9 quests, among them Phantasm Hunter, Marathon and Sector Sweep. It also let you fade every HUD window with one opacity setting. Free on Steam, link in bio.
#spacegame #indiegame #indiedev #mmorpg #mmo #gamedev #pcgaming #scifi #freetoplay #spaceships

Every season ended the same way: a black hole eruption Back on January 24, 2026, update 0.0.12 of our browser prototype added seasons and wipes. You earned Wipe Points by playing and spent them in the Wipe Store on permanent boosts. Your equipped ship was protected. Free on Steam, link in bio.
#spacegame #indiegame #indiedev #mmorpg #mmo #gamedev #pcgaming #scifi #freetoplay #spaceships

The first way to support the game Back on January 13, 2026, update 0.0.9 of our browser prototype added subscriptions. Payments went through Stripe, and premium status showed in one place in the interface. Free on Steam, link in bio.
#spacegame #indiegame #indiedev #mmorpg #mmo #gamedev #pcgaming #scifi #freetoplay #spaceships

A quest window worth opening Back on January 12, 2026, update 0.0.8 of our browser prototype polished the quest system. Smoother quest features, cleaner visuals, and per-player logging so we could chase bugs faster. Free on Steam, link in bio.
#spacegame #indiegame #indiedev #mmorpg #mmo #gamedev #pcgaming #scifi #freetoplay #spaceships

The day pilots stopped flying alone Back in January 2026, update 0.0.7 of our browser prototype added clans. Create one, join one, manage it, and compete with other clans on the leaderboards. Free on Steam, link in bio.
#spacegame #indiegame #indiedev #mmorpg #mmo #gamedev #pcgaming #scifi #freetoplay #spaceships

Your own base, running while you fly Back in January 2026, update 0.0.6 of our browser prototype added Skylab. You managed modules, produced resources and toggled module power. Assembly for crafting came in the same update. Free on Steam, link in bio.
#spacegame #indiegame #indiedev #mmorpg #mmo #gamedev #pcgaming #scifi #freetoplay #spaceships

Before SpaceCorps 2027, there was a browser game Back on January 11, 2026, update 0.0.5 of our browser prototype laid the foundation. Ship combat against players and aliens, portal jumps, a minimap, quests, a shop and a drag-and-drop hangar. Eight months later we rebuilt it as a native game. Free on Steam, link in bio.
